function.name: D3DXCreatePolygon
function.signature: HRESULT WINAPI D3DXCreatePolygon(struct IDirect3DDevice9 *device, float length, UINT sides, struct ID3DXMesh **mesh, struct ID3DXBuffer **adjacency)

docs.text:
--- description: Uses a left-handed coordinate system to create a mesh containing an n-sided polygon. ms.assetid: f3313f55-3e60-4440-8bea-d2886b636c9a title: D3DXCreatePolygon function (D3dx9shape.h) ms.topic: reference ms.date: 05/31/2018 topic_type: - APIRef - kbSyntax api_name: - D3DXCreatePolygon api_type: - LibDef api_location: - d3dx9.lib - d3dx9.dll --- # D3DXCreatePolygon function Uses a left-handed coordinate system to create a mesh containing an n-sided polygon. ## Syntax ```C++ HRESULT D3DXCreatePolygon( _In_  LPDIRECT3DDEVICE9 pDevice, _In_  FLOAT             Length, _In_  UINT              Sides, _Out_ LPD3DXMESH        *ppMesh, _Out_ LPD3DXBUFFER      *ppAdjacency ); ``` ## Parameters
*pDevice* \[in\]
Type: **[**LPDIRECT3DDEVICE9**](/windows/win32/api/d3d9helper/nn-d3d9helper-idirect3ddevice9)** Pointer to an [**IDirect3DDevice9**](/windows/win32/api/d3d9helper/nn-d3d9helper-idirect3ddevice9) interface, representing the device associated with the created polygon mesh.
*Length* \[in\]
Type: **[**FLOAT**](../winprog/windows-data-types.md)** Length of each side.
*Sides* \[in\]
Type: **[**UINT**](../winprog/windows-data-types.md)** Number of sides for the polygon. Value must be greater than or equal to 3.
*ppMesh* \[out\]
Type: **[**LPD3DXMESH**](id3dxmesh.md)\*** Address of a pointer to the output shape, an [**ID3DXMesh**](id3dxmesh.md) interface.
*ppAdjacency* \[out\]
Type: **[**LPD3DXBUFFER**](id3dxbuffer.md)\*** Address of a pointer to an [**ID3DXBuffer**](id3dxbuffer.md) interface. When the method returns, this parameter is filled with an array of three DWORDs per face that specify the three neighbors for each face in the mesh. **NULL** can be specified.
## Return value Type: **[**HRESULT**](https://msdn.microsoft.com/library/Bb401631(v=MSDN.10).aspx)** If the function succeeds, the return value is D3D\_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the following: D3DERR\_INVALIDCALL, D3DXERR\_INVALIDDATA, E\_OUTOFMEMORY. ## Remarks The created polygon is centered at the origin. This function creates a mesh with the D3DXMESH\_MANAGED creation option and [D3DFVF\_XYZ \| D3DFVF\_NORMAL](d3dfvf.md) flexible vertex format (FVF). ## Requirements | Requirement | Value | |--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | Header
